column1: # Expected results for single .dockerignore patterns, as computed by github.com/moby/patternmatcher v0.6.1
# (the matcher used by the Docker CLI and BuildKit), via patternmatcher.MatchesOrParentMatches(path, [pattern]).
# Includes the cases from moby/patternmatcher's own patternmatcher_test.go (Apache License 2.0) plus additional ones.
# Patterns and paths are already cleaned (filepath.Clean). Columns, tab-separated: pattern, path, expected,
# where expected is true, false or invalid.
